name: Scholarships to Meritorious Students of Sanskrit Schools
benefit: 1. Meritorious students of Prathmik Madhyama (Class 10) are awarded a scholarship of ₹500 per month for 20 months. 1. Three meritorious students of Uttar Madhyama (Class 12) are awarded cash prizes: - **First Position:** ₹20,000/-- **Second Position:** ₹15,000/-- **Third Position:** ₹10,000/-
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student of a recognized Sanskrit school under the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad. 1. The applicant must have secured a place in the top 10 in the class 10th merit list or in the top 3 in the class 12th merit list from the Board Examination of Sanskrit School. 1. The applicant must be currently studying in class 11th or 12th after clearing class 10th. <br>
